name: DI
description: Attempts to resurrect a dead character - success depends on Vitality

onSuccess.notes: Character returns with 1 HP; Vitality permanently reduced by 1

onFailure.notes: Character is converted to ASHES status

resurrection.criticalWarning: If Vitality is 3 or lower when cast, failure results in character being permanently LOST

comparison: Temple of Cant is safer with (50 + 3×Vitality)% success rate
